title: Bichana Chod de
body:
Bichana Chod de
Chod den..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum bhala kis tarha Karbala chod den-chod den
Hum agar farshe aza Ghar Ghar bichana chod den..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aasmaa'n wale..(2) zami'n par aana jaana chod den..
Hum agar farshe aza Ghar Ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Ay zami'n tujhme na ho gar sar zameen e Karbala..(2)
Chand aur sooraj tere chakkar lagana chod den..
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum agar...
2) Nashr ho jayen Jo sab tere fazail Karbala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
RABB E KAABAH ki qasam sab Hajj pe Jana chod den..
Hum agar..
<<DIVIDER>>
3) PANJATAN A.S ne khud padhi hai jab to phir ay dosto'n,..(2)
Kis tarha se hum..(2) namaz e panjgana chod den..
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum agar...
4) ASGHAR e MASOOM A.S  k lab par tabassum aa gaya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Phool kaliyo'n se..(2) kaho ab muskurana chod den..
Hum agar...
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Sheikh ji ahle wila ko na samajh samjha hai kya..(2)
Tere kehne par..(2) wilayat ka khazana chod den..
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum agar..
6) Waqt ruk jayega tham jayega sooraj ka safar,..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
FATEMA ZAHRA S.A agar chakki chalana chod den..
Hum agar...
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Shauq se pee Len nusairy hubb e HAIDER A.S ki sharab, Bas guzarish hai k pee kar ladkhadana chod den..
Hum agar...
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Maatam e SHABBIR A.S me uthte nahi hain Jo kabhi..(2)
Hath Akbar aise logo'n se milana chod den..
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum agar farshe aza Ghar Ghar bichana chod den..
author: Mir Hassan Mir
